entities.name: Query SecA ATPase
observations: 768 aa protein sequence matches reviewed SecA proteins with up to 100% identity and full query coverage.
Contains SecA_DEAD, DEAD, SecA_PP_bind, P-loop_SecA, and SecA_SW domains.
Predicted molecular weight is 86.47 kDa; theoretical pI is 5.04.

entities.name: SecA
observations: SecA is the ATP-driven motor of the bacterial Sec protein translocase and interacts with the SecYEG channel.
Reviewed homologs annotate EC 7.4.2.8, protein-exporting ATPase activity, and ATP hydrolysis coupled to protein translocation.
Reviewed homologs may bind one Zn2+ ion per subunit.

entities.name: SecA-coupled protein translocation ATP hydrolysis
observations: Overall reaction: ATP + H2O + cellular protein (side 1) → ADP + phosphate + cellular protein (side 2).
ATP hydrolysis is coupled to stepwise transfer of a preprotein through the SecYEG membrane channel.

entities.name: SecA Zn2+ cofactor
observations: Reviewed SecA homologs report a possible bound Zn2+ ion, approximately one per subunit; this is an annotation of homologs rather than a direct measurement for the query sequence.
